invariants.rationale: The parameter 'result' is dereferenced; hence, it must be non-null.
At method exit, commit metadata is set using Option.of(...), so it is expected to be present.
getWriteStatuses() is called in the method; therefore, the return value must not be null.
getPartitionToReplaceFileIds() is passed as an argument for metadata construction; hence, it must not be null.
